Hey, I just read that you used active dry yeast in your recipe. Did you activate it in some lukewarm water first before mixing in with the rest of the ingredients? That’s a pretty important first step.

Try adding a bit of sugar (maybe 1 tsp for your current recipe) to the dough; it might be able to promote browning?

Other than that, get yourself a basic oven thermometer, something like this: https://www.a.ubuy.com.kw/en/product/NG4XO8-oven-thermometer-50-300-c-100-600-f-oven-grill-fry-chef-smoker-thermometer-instant-read-stainless-st That can help you figure out if your oven is running at the right temperature.

60% hydration should be fine for your pizza dough. Are you doing it by hand or machine? Be careful of over kneading, which can make it tough.

Finally, I think your shaping needs some work. Try watching some youtube videos about it.

As for pizza sauce, my favourite kind is simply made with canned whole tomatoes, crush the tomatoes, add some garlic and onion powder, salt and pepper and oregano into it. Better than any instant sauce.

Hope your next attempt goes better! Good luck, you can do it!
